definition: Candidate continuity of a future-state tendency across Field or Context transitions when supporting conditions remain unresolved or reactivate.
core_rules: Field transition does not imply Intent termination
Context transition does not imply Intent termination
unfinished-work Intent may remain active after a physical move from office to home
carryover must preserve source owners, provenance, uncertainty, and temporal trace
carryover may weaken, become suppressed or dormant, or reactivate
no fixed duration threshold is frozen

mental_field_continuity_relation.rule: Mental Field Continuity can provide a reference that supports carryover, but Intent Governance does not own or mutate it.
